from fractions import Fraction as Fr
import json

def f(k, x):
    return k * x * x + (k - 1) * x + 3

# Exhaustive search over rationals k = p/q with |p| <= 20, 1 <= q <= 4.
sample_x = [Fr(n, 4) for n in range(-12, 13)]
even_ks = []
seen = set()
for q in range(1, 5):
    for p in range(-20, 21):
        k = Fr(p, q)
        if k in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(k)
        if all(f(k, x) == f(k, -x) for x in sample_x):
            even_ks.append(k)

# Evenness of kx^2+(k-1)x+3 requires the linear coefficient to vanish.
assert len(even_ks) == 1, even_ks
k = even_ks[0]
a, b = k, k - 1
assert a > 0  # parabola opens upward, so it decreases to the left of the vertex

# Vertex x = -b/(2a); decreasing interval is (-inf, vertex] for a > 0.
vertex = -b / (2 * a)

# Grid check: f strictly decreasing on consecutive samples left of the vertex,
# and not decreasing on consecutive samples right of it.
grid = [Fr(n, 8) for n in range(-80, 81)]
dec_ok = all(f(k, grid[i]) > f(k, grid[i + 1])
             for i in range(len(grid) - 1) if grid[i + 1] <= vertex)
inc_ok = all(f(k, grid[i]) < f(k, grid[i + 1])
             for i in range(len(grid) - 1) if grid[i] >= vertex)
assert dec_ok and inc_ok

final_answer = "(-∞, 0]" if vertex == 0 else "UNSUPPORTED"

print(json.dumps({
    "final_answer": final_answer,
    "evidence": {
        "k": str(k),
        "linear_coefficient": str(b),
        "vertex": str(vertex),
        "even_k_candidates": [str(v) for v in even_ks],
        "grid_checks": {"decreasing_left": dec_ok, "increasing_right": inc_ok}
    }
}, ensure_ascii=False))
